findings.detail: Low ANC/platelet and current diarrhoea/stomatitis hold rules require delay duration. Pure rule-engine evaluation of isolated ANC0.9, platelets60, diarrhoea grade2 or stomatitis grade2 produces consultant_review with no matching findings, so the source-specific hold instruction is missing. This is not a claim that the UI clears treatment.
findings.recommendation: Make hold condition independent of duration. Keep duration-specific stop rules at higher priority; say confirm delay duration before restarting.
boundary_tests: ANC1.49 hold without delay;1.5 no low-ANC hold
Platelets74.9 hold without delay;75 no low-platelet hold
Current diarrhoea2 hold without duration;stomatitis2 hold without duration
Low counts with delay4 stop;diarrhoea4wk stop;stomatitis2wk stop

findings.detail: Low day1 counts and current diarrhoea/stomatitis/HFS hold rules require optional delay duration. Isolated ANC0.9, platelets60, diarrhoea2, stomatitis2 or HFS2 yield no finding.
findings.recommendation: Make immediate hold independent of duration, while retaining stop rules at two weeks. Preserve baseline ANC1.5/platelets100 versus subsequent-cycle ANC1.2/platelets75 distinctions.

Current grade2 diarrhoea/stomatitis/HFS hold without duration

findings.detail: Capecitabine table states30-50=>75%,51-80=>no adjustment; existing encoding has no explicit pathway for unrounded50<CrCl<51.
findings.recommendation: Add consultant review for this source-table gap, do not round to infer a dose. This parallels the existing00586/00623 boundary guards.

findings.detail: Patient knowledge/monitoring has no warfarin/INR mention although source requires baseline and regular INR when on warfarin, as clinically indicated.
findings.recommendation: Add conditional INR to monitoring and medication review; do not imply all patients need INR.

findings.detail: Patient chapter only says warfarin can need closer INR checks, and monitoring grid lacks the explicit source cadence.
findings.recommendation: Add if taking warfarin: weekly INR until stable warfarin dose established, then before each cycle. Preserve existing BP before and post-treatment and urine protein monitoring.

findings.detail: Patient materials give general cold precautions but omit explicit avoidance of ice chips during bolus fluorouracil in the oxaliplatin-containing schedule.
findings.recommendation: Add no ice chips with this regimen; retain clinically assessed breathing symptoms rather than automatically labelling them cold dysaesthesia.

findings.source_location: p2 exclusions; p3 Table2; p4 Table3
findings.detail: Existing exact hepatic boundary review at bilirubin85/AST180 and ANC recovery after>2wk review are appropriate. Source ANC table itself says hold maximum2wk but discontinue after4wk. Source excludes impaired renal function yet Table3 provides CrCl>=10 no adjustment and<10 dose range.
findings.recommendation: Keep source conflicts visible; do not collapse2wk/4wk into single threshold or auto-select dose from50-66%. Consider explicit renal source-conflict review if not surfaced elsewhere.

findings.detail: Source narrative says treatment-related diarrhoea fully resolved before irinotecan, while Table4 permits resumption below grade2. Existing generic proceed condition accepts current grade1.
findings.recommendation: Add review at grade1 diarrhoea to expose narrative/table ambiguity, particularly before restart. Do not claim grade1 alone proves irinotecan readiness.

findings.detail: Correct existing schedule is capecitabine825mg/m2 twice daily Days1-5 in7-day cycles with RT, maximum5-6cycles. Weekly cycle bloods are source-based. Existing renal50-51gap guard and graded recurrent toxicity logic are present.
findings.recommendation: Retain this distinct regimen; do not change to7days continuous tablets or importCAPOX14day course. New patient summary should distinguish radiation appointments from tablet days and retain prescribed duration.

findings.detail: Current source gives capecitabine100% forCrCl>=30, while supplementary capecitabine SmPC1250mg/m2 dosing distinguishes30-50. Existing RENAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT/RENAL_GAP correctly avoid automatic normal dose. Within-cycleANC<1/platelets<75 differs from subsequent recoveryANC>=1.5.
findings.recommendation: Preserve source-conflict review and within-cycle versus subsequent-dose logic; do not inheritCAPOX renal dose silently.

supportive_care_confirmations.00209: Moderate-risk oxaliplatin; low-risk5FU; source forbids ice chips with oxaliplatin. Existing moderate antiemetic plan present.
supportive_care_confirmations.00321: Moderate-risk oxaliplatin; oral minimal-low capecitabine. Existing separate capecitabine loperamide4mg then2mg after loose stool,max16mg/day matches source.
supportive_care_confirmations.00227: Prophylactic atropine250micrograms SC unless contraindicated/glaucoma; delayed diarrhoea loperamide4mg then2mg q2h,continue12h after last liquid stool,max48h high-dose. Existing support preserves distinction from capecitabine rescue.
supportive_care_confirmations.00586: Oral low-minimal; no routine premedication; loperamide rescue per source. Radiation dose/fractions require personal radiation plan.
supportive_care_confirmations.00623: No routine bevacizumab premedication unless prior hypersensitivity; BP/proteinuria/wounds distinct from nausea plan. Existing oral low-minimal support retained.

evidence_content_review.00209: Existing patient evidence correctly qualifies MOSAIC as FOLFOX4 rather than directly measured mFOLFOX6 effect; no numeric patient benefit claim.
evidence_content_review.00321: Existing patient evidence limits NO16968 to postoperative stageIII colon; does not extrapolate to metastatic/gastric contexts.
evidence_content_review.00227: Existing sequence trial summary separates colorectal results from oesophageal/pancreatic indications.
evidence_content_review.00586: Existing rectal chemoradiation summary includes whole treatment programme including surgery.
evidence_content_review.00623: Existing AVEX explanation acknowledges older unsuitable-for-doublet population and different starting capecitabine dose; no extra-lifespan promise.
